# Vaporesso

> > Vaporesso is a leading vaping technology brand offering innovative devices, chipsets, and educational resources for vapers worldwide.

Vaporesso manufactures premium vape kits, mods, tanks, and pods featuring proprietary technologies like AXON CHIP, OMNI BOARD, CCELL coils, and PTF System. The site provides comprehensive guides for beginners and advanced users, product specifications across multiple languages, and regulatory compliance information including PMTA, TPD, and CRC certifications.

## Key Topics

- AXON CHIP
- OMNI BOARD
- CCELL Coil Technology
- PTF System
- Gen S Series
- Sub-Ohm Vaping
- PMTA Compliance
- TPD Regulations
- CRC Certification
- Meshed Coil Technology
- Pulse Mode
- Temperature Control
- VG/PG Ratios
- 18650 Batteries
- Dry Hit Protection

## Vape Kits & Devices

- [DEGREE POD Device](https://www.vaporesso.com/ar/vape-kits/degree): DEGREE POD device with AXON CHIP and dry hit protection (Arabic)
- [Gen S 220W Kit](https://www.vaporesso.com/es/vape-kits/gen-s): Gen S 220W kit with NRG-S Tank and GT MESHED coil (Spanish)
- [Gen S Kit (Arabic)](https://www.vaporesso.com/ar/vape-kits/gen-s): Gen S 220W kit with AXON CHIP and NRG-S Tank (Arabic)
- [Target Mini Mod](https://www.vaporesso.com/es/vape-batteries-mods/target-mini): Target Mini 40W compact mod with 1400mAh battery (Spanish)

## Technology & Innovation

- [Axon Chip Technology](https://www.vaporesso.com/es/axon-chip): Axon Chip technology with pulse, echo, TC modes and DIY (Spanish)
- [Omni Board Chipset](https://www.vaporesso.com/es/omni-board): Omni Board chipset technology with insta-fire and quick charge (Spanish)
- [DEGREE Replacement Pods](https://www.vaporesso.com/ar/vape-tanks/degree-pod): DEGREE replacement pods with CCELL and MESHED coil options (Arabic)

## Beginner Guides

- [How to Get Started with Your First Vape Kit](https://www.vaporesso.com/blog/how-to-get-started-with-your-first-vape-kit): Beginner's guide to vape starter kits including XROS 4
- [Vaping 101: How Vaporizers Work](https://www.vaporesso.com/blog/vaping-101-how-vaporizers-work): Beginner guide explaining vaporizer technology and atomizer basics
- [How to Choose the Right E-Liquid](https://www.vaporesso.com/blog/how-to-choose-the-right-eliquid): Guide to selecting e-liquid: VG/PG ratios, nicotine strength, and flavors
- [Where to Buy Vape Devices and Supplies](https://www.vaporesso.com/blog/where-to-buy-vape-devices-and-supplies): Guide to shopping for Vaporesso vape products online and offline

## Advanced Vaping Techniques

- [What Is Sub Ohm Vaping](https://www.vaporesso.com/blog/what-is-sub-ohm-vaping-everything-you-need-to-know-for-huge-clouds): Advanced guide to sub-ohm vaping and cloud chasing with Ohm's law
- [How to Steep E-Juice](https://www.vaporesso.com/blog/how-to-steep-e-juice): E-liquid steeping methods for enhanced flavor development
- [The Best Replaceable Vape Batteries](https://www.vaporesso.com/blog/the-best-replaceable-vape-batteries): Battery guide covering 18650 batteries including Samsung 25R
